description: Generates a trigger when an input signal turns around, crosses a threshold, or both, with a scope drawing the signal and its triggers

params.text: Picks what makes a trigger: direction, where the signal turns from rising to falling or back; through zero, where it crosses the threshold; or both of those
Sets the threshold crossed in through zero mode, -10V to 10V
Sets the chance that a trigger is generated when the condition is met, 0 to 100%

inputs.text: The signal the triggers are taken from, 16 channels at most, each channel having its own scope tab
Scales the threshold set by the zero knob, 10V giving the full knob value and negative voltages flipping its sign
0-10V scales the chance set by the prob knob, 10V giving the full knob value

outputs.text: A 1ms 10V trigger at each crossing, or in latch mode a gate that flips between 0V and 10V at each crossing

notes: the numbered tabs above and below the scope pick which channel of signal is drawn, and the menu's scope mode and time scale apply to the channel picked there.
a channel tab is picked by clicking it, by scrolling sideways over the tabs, or with the left and right arrow keys while the pointer is over them.
clicking the scope switches the channel being shown between bipolar and unipolar.
scrolling on the scope sets how long a span of signal the whole trace covers, 0.1 to 10 seconds, for every channel at once.
menu: freeze when idle — holds the scope drawing in place while signal is unpatched, in place of clearing it
trigger mode — trigger gives a 1ms pulse at each crossing, latch flips the output between 0V and 10V at each crossing
scope mode — bipolar draws the channel being shown centred on 0V, unipolar draws it from 0V upwards
time scale — sets how many samples the drawing of the channel being shown is built from: low 64, medium 256, high 2048
